# obol.setup

:::caution[v3 release candidate, unreleased]

This is the reference for `@obolnetwork/obol-sdk@3.0.0-rc.12`, generated from its source and spec. Names and shapes may still change before 3.0.0, and it is not on npm `latest`. For the released SDK see the [2.x reference](../../sdk/index.md).

:::

Deploys an Obol Validator Manager (OVM) and the SplitV2 splits behind its principal and reward recipients, in one transaction where possible. The presets (`rewardsSplit`, `totalSplit`, `solo`) turn a list of recipients into the `prepareOvmWithSplits` input with the Obol RAF share added. The OVM address is the withdrawal address the cluster definition commits to, so this usually comes first.

Withdrawal and reward contracts</a></span><span class="sdk-fact"><span class="sdk-fact__k">Types</span> <a href="./types/setup">9 on the types page</a></span></div>

<div class="sdk-table">

| Method | Summary |
|---|---|
| [`rewardsSplit`](#rewardsSplit) | Rewards to a split (`recipients`, summing to 990000, plus the RAF 10000); principal to `principalRecipient`. |
| [`totalSplit`](#totalSplit) | Rewards to a split (`recipients` plus the RAF), principal to a second split: `principalRecipients` (sum 1_000_000, no RAF) or Split Everything. |
| [`solo`](#solo) | One operator: rewards to a split of `recipient` (990000) and the RAF (10000); principal straight to `recipient`. |
| [`ovmSplitParams`](#ovmSplitParams) | The exact SplitV2 params the presets create. |
| [`prepareOvmWithSplits`](#prepareOvmWithSplits) | Deploys an OVM and the splits behind its recipients in one transaction (Multicall3), reusing splits that exist (SPLIT_REUSED). |
| [`prepareCreateOvm`](#prepareCreateOvm) | Deploys an OVM through the Obol factory with the given owner, recipients and principal threshold (default 16 ETH). |
| [`ovmFromReceipt`](#ovmFromReceipt) | The OVM created by a mined transaction, from the `CreateObolValidatorManager` log emitted by the chain's OVM factory (logs from other addresses are ignored). |
| [`DEFAULT_PRINCIPAL_THRESHOLD`](#DEFAULT_PRINCIPAL_THRESHOLD) | Default OVM principal threshold, 16 ETH in wei: a distribution of at least this much is paid as principal while `amountOfPrincipalStake` lasts. |
| [`MAX_PRINCIPAL_THRESHOLD`](#MAX_PRINCIPAL_THRESHOLD) | Largest principal threshold the factory accepts (2048 ETH, wei). |
| [`MIN_PRINCIPAL_THRESHOLD`](#MIN_PRINCIPAL_THRESHOLD) | Smallest principal threshold the SDK accepts (16 ETH, wei). |

### setup.rewardsSplit {#rewardsSplit}

<div class="sdk-badges"><span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--tag" title="Where it reads from (spec tag)">pure</span></div>

Rewards to a split (`recipients`, summing to 990000, plus the RAF 10000);
principal to `principalRecipient`. Returns the `prepareOvmWithSplits` input.

```ts sdk-signature
obol.setup.rewardsSplit(
  input: Preset<typeof rewardsSplit>,
): OvmWithSplitsInput
```

| <code>input</code> | <span class="sdk-type">Preset&lt;typeof rewardsSplit&gt;</span> |  |

| <code>input.owner</code> | <span class="sdk-type">Address</span> | The OVM owner. <span class="sdk-from">from <span class="sdk-type"><a href="./types/setup#PresetOptions">PresetOptions</a></span></span> |
| <code>input.principalThreshold?</code> | <span class="sdk-type">bigint</span> | wei; default 16 ETH. <span class="sdk-from">from <span class="sdk-type"><a href="./types/setup#PresetOptions">PresetOptions</a></span></span> |
| <code>input.splitOwner?</code> | <span class="sdk-type">Address</span> | Owner of the splits; default the zero address (immutable). <span class="sdk-from">from <span class="sdk-type"><a href="./types/setup#PresetOptions">PresetOptions</a></span></span> |
| <code>input.salt?</code> | <span class="sdk-type">Hex</span> |  <span class="sdk-from">from <span class="sdk-type"><a href="./types/setup#PresetOptions">PresetOptions</a></span></span> |

</div>

**Returns** <span class="sdk-type"><a href="./types/setup#OvmWithSplitsInput">OvmWithSplitsInput</a></span>

**Example**

```ts
import { setup } from '@obolnetwork/obol-sdk';

// Rewards to the operators (shares sum to 99%; the Obol RAF gets 1%), principal to one address.
const input = obol.setup.rewardsSplit({
  owner: account,
  principalRecipient: account,
  recipients: [
    { address: '0x5c2f1a8a6a0b3b0ad7a3d8d5f0b6f4c7e2a1b9c3', share: 495_000 },
    { address: '0x9a1b2c3d4e5f60718293a4b5c6d7e8f901234567', share: 495_000 },
  ],
});
```

### setup.ovmSplitParams {#ovmSplitParams}

<div class="sdk-badges"><span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--tag" title="Where it reads from (spec tag)">pure</span></div>

The exact SplitV2 params the presets create. Reward split: the reward
shares must sum to 990000 and the chain's RAF recipient is added with
10000. Principal split (`kind: "total"` only): `principalRecipients`
summing to 1_000_000 (no RAF), or, without them, "Split Everything": each
reward recipient gets its share plus `floor(10000 / n)`, and `10000 mod n`
goes to the first in numeric address order. Recipients are sorted by
numeric address. Failures are PAYLOAD_INVALID with an `issue`
(`principal_not_allowed` for principal recipients on a rewards split).

```ts sdk-signature
obol.setup.ovmSplitParams(
  input: Preset<typeof ovmSplitParams>,
): ReturnType<typeof ovmSplitParams>
```

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--fields">

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <code>input</code> | <span class="sdk-type">Preset&lt;typeof ovmSplitParams&gt;</span> |  |
| <code>input.kind</code> | <span class="sdk-type">'rewards' &#124; 'total'</span> |  |
| <code>input.rewardRecipients</code> | <span class="sdk-type"><a href="./types/splits#ShareRecipient">ShareRecipient</a>[]</span> |  |
| <code>input.principalRecipients?</code> | <span class="sdk-type"><a href="./types/splits#ShareRecipient">ShareRecipient</a>[]</span> |  |
| <code>input.distributionIncentive?</code> | <span class="sdk-type">number</span> |  |

</div>

**Returns** <span class="sdk-type">ReturnType&lt;typeof ovmSplitParams&gt;</span>

**Example**

```ts
import { setup } from '@obolnetwork/obol-sdk';

const { rewardSplit } = obol.setup.ovmSplitParams({
  kind: 'rewards',
  rewardRecipients: [{ address: account, share: 990_000 }],
});
```

## Transactions {#group-transactions}

### setup.prepareOvmWithSplits {#prepareOvmWithSplits}

<div class="sdk-badges"><span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--tag" title="Where it reads from (spec tag)">chain</span> <span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--throws">throws 4</span> <a class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--stage" href="../lifecycle#rewards">2. Withdrawal and reward contracts</a></div>

Deploys an OVM and the splits behind its recipients in one transaction (Multicall3),
reusing splits that exist (SPLIT_REUSED). Build the input with `rewardsSplit`,
`totalSplit` or `solo`. Each send creates a new OVM: after an unknown outcome, look for
the earlier `CreateObolValidatorManager` event before retrying.

```ts sdk-signature
obol.setup.prepareOvmWithSplits(
  input: OvmWithSplitsInput,
): Promise<Prepared<'ovmWithSplits'>>
```

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--fields">

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <code>input</code> | <span class="sdk-type"><a href="./types/setup#OvmWithSplitsInput">OvmWithSplitsInput</a></span> |  |
| <code>input.owner</code> | <span class="sdk-type">string</span> |  |
| <code>input.principalThreshold?</code> | <span class="sdk-type">bigint</span> | wei; default 16 ETH. |
| <code>input.reward</code> | <span class="sdk-type"><a href="./types/setup#OvmRecipientInput">OvmRecipientInput</a></span> |  |
| <code>input.principal</code> | <span class="sdk-type"><a href="./types/setup#OvmRecipientInput">OvmRecipientInput</a></span> |  |

</div>

**Returns** <span class="sdk-type">Promise&lt;<a href="./types/send#Prepared">Prepared</a>&lt;'ovmWithSplits'&gt;&gt;</span>: a `Prepared` of kind `'ovmWithSplits'`, preview <span class="sdk-type"><a href="./types/send#PreviewByKind">PreviewByKind</a>['ovmWithSplits']</span>. Send it with [`obol.send`](./send.md#send) or your wallet layer.

**Throws** <span class="sdk-muted">(per spec)</span> <a class="sdk-chip sdk-chip--error" href="../errors#CONTRACT_NOT_AVAILABLE">CONTRACT_NOT_AVAILABLE</a> <a class="sdk-chip sdk-chip--error" href="../errors#CHAIN_READ_FAILED">CHAIN_READ_FAILED</a> <a class="sdk-chip sdk-chip--error" href="../errors#PUBLIC_FORWARDER_AS_OWNER">PUBLIC_FORWARDER_AS_OWNER</a> <a class="sdk-chip sdk-chip--error" href="../errors#PUBLIC_FORWARDER_AS_RECIPIENT">PUBLIC_FORWARDER_AS_RECIPIENT</a> <span class="sdk-muted">plus the [checks every operation runs](../errors.md#checks-every-operation-runs)</span>

**Can report** <a class="sdk-chip sdk-chip--info" href="../warnings#SPLIT_REUSED" title="info">SPLIT_REUSED</a> <a class="sdk-chip sdk-chip--info" href="../warnings#RECIPIENT_NOT_CONTRACT" title="info">RECIPIENT_NOT_CONTRACT</a>

**Example**

```ts
import { splits, setup } from '@obolnetwork/obol-sdk';

const tx = await obol.setup.prepareOvmWithSplits(
  obol.setup.solo({ owner: account, recipient: account }), // or rewardsSplit / totalSplit, or your own input
); // splits that exist already are reused (SPLIT_REUSED)
const sent = await obol.send(tx);
const created = obol.setup.ovmFromReceipt(await sent.wait());
console.log('OVM', created.ovm); // the withdrawal address for the cluster definition
```

<details class="sdk-spec">
<summary>Specification: setup.prepareOvmWithSplits</summary>

Tag: `chain`. Inputs:

```
{ owner: Address, principalThreshold: bigint?,
  reward: { split: { recipients, distributionIncentive?, owner?, salt? } } | { address: Address },
  principal: { split: (same) } | { address: Address } }
```

1. Each `split` passes `splitParams`; `predictSplit` gives its address and `exists`.
2. `prepareCreateOvm` checks with the predicted / given addresses. Multicall3 code check ([`CONTRACT_NOT_AVAILABLE`](../errors.md#CONTRACT_NOT_AVAILABLE)).
3. Existing splits are skipped: Finding [`SPLIT_REUSED`](../warnings.md#SPLIT_REUSED) (info) with the address. (2.15)

Output: `Prepared<"ovmWithSplits">`, preview `{ rewardRecipient: { address, created: bool }, principalRecipient: (same) }`:

- some split to create: Multicall3 `aggregate3([createSplitDeterministic…, createObolValidatorManager(…)])`, all
  `allowFailure: false`;
- nothing to create: the direct factory call of `prepareCreateOvm`.

Idempotent for the splits only: each send creates a new OVM. A retry after an unknown outcome should first look for
the earlier `CreateObolValidatorManager` event (by owner, `topic2`).

<p class="sdk-muted">From <a href="https://github.com/ObolNetwork/obol-sdk/blob/080fa554c999b11c014f3f09be26274014ded0b9/spec/operations.md">spec/operations.md</a>.</p>

</details>

<p class="sdk-see">See also: <a href="https://github.com/ObolNetwork/obol-sdk/blob/080fa554c999b11c014f3f09be26274014ded0b9/spec/operations.md#setupprepareovmwithsplits">spec/operations.md</a> · <a href="https://github.com/ObolNetwork/obol-sdk/blob/080fa554c999b11c014f3f09be26274014ded0b9/spec/schemas/setup.prepareOvmWithSplits.json">input JSON Schema</a> · <a href="https://github.com/ObolNetwork/obol-sdk/blob/080fa554c999b11c014f3f09be26274014ded0b9/src/setup/index.ts#L59">source</a></p>

### setup.prepareCreateOvm {#prepareCreateOvm}

<div class="sdk-badges"><span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--tag" title="Where it reads from (spec tag)">chain</span> <span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--throws">throws 4</span> <a class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--stage" href="../lifecycle#rewards">2. Withdrawal and reward contracts</a></div>

Deploys an OVM through the Obol factory with the given owner, recipients and principal
threshold (default 16 ETH). The address is known after mining: `ovmFromReceipt`.
A recipient with no code: RECIPIENT_NOT_CONTRACT (info).

```ts sdk-signature
obol.setup.prepareCreateOvm(
  input: CreateOvmInput,
): Promise<Prepared<'createOvm'>>
```

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--fields">

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <code>input</code> | <span class="sdk-type"><a href="./types/setup#CreateOvmInput">CreateOvmInput</a></span> |  |
| <code>input.owner</code> | <span class="sdk-type">string</span> |  |
| <code>input.principalRecipient</code> | <span class="sdk-type">string</span> | Any address: a split, an EOA, a Safe. |
| <code>input.rewardRecipient</code> | <span class="sdk-type">string</span> |  |
| <code>input.principalThreshold?</code> | <span class="sdk-type">bigint</span> | wei, whole gwei, 16 to 2048 ETH; default 16 ETH. |

</div>

**Returns** <span class="sdk-type">Promise&lt;<a href="./types/send#Prepared">Prepared</a>&lt;'createOvm'&gt;&gt;</span>: a `Prepared` of kind `'createOvm'`, preview <span class="sdk-type"><a href="./types/send#PreviewByKind">PreviewByKind</a>['createOvm']</span>. Send it with [`obol.send`](./send.md#send) or your wallet layer.

**Throws** <span class="sdk-muted">(per spec)</span> <a class="sdk-chip sdk-chip--error" href="../errors#CONTRACT_NOT_AVAILABLE">CONTRACT_NOT_AVAILABLE</a> <a class="sdk-chip sdk-chip--error" href="../errors#CHAIN_READ_FAILED">CHAIN_READ_FAILED</a> <a class="sdk-chip sdk-chip--error" href="../errors#PUBLIC_FORWARDER_AS_OWNER">PUBLIC_FORWARDER_AS_OWNER</a> <a class="sdk-chip sdk-chip--error" href="../errors#PUBLIC_FORWARDER_AS_RECIPIENT">PUBLIC_FORWARDER_AS_RECIPIENT</a> <span class="sdk-muted">plus the [checks every operation runs](../errors.md#checks-every-operation-runs)</span>

**Can report** <a class="sdk-chip sdk-chip--info" href="../warnings#RECIPIENT_NOT_CONTRACT" title="info">RECIPIENT_NOT_CONTRACT</a>

**Example**

```ts
import { setup } from '@obolnetwork/obol-sdk';

const ovmTx = await obol.setup.prepareCreateOvm({
  owner: account,
  principalRecipient: account,
  rewardRecipient: '0x5c2f1a8a6a0b3b0ad7a3d8d5f0b6f4c7e2a1b9c3', // a split you created, or any address
});
```

<details class="sdk-spec">
<summary>Specification: setup.prepareCreateOvm</summary>

Tag: `chain`. Inputs: `{ owner: Address, principalRecipient: Address, rewardRecipient: Address, principalThreshold:
bigint (wei, default 16 ETH) }`. Any addresses: a split, an EOA, a Safe.

1. All three addresses non-zero (factory and constructor revert otherwise). (2.15 schema + contract)
2. `principalThreshold` whole gwei, 16 ETH ≤ t ≤ 2048 ETH. (2.15 minimum 16; maximum from the factory)
3. Factory code equals the expected bytecode, else [`CONTRACT_NOT_AVAILABLE`](../errors.md#CONTRACT_NOT_AVAILABLE). (2.15)
4. A recipient with no code: Finding [`RECIPIENT_NOT_CONTRACT`](../warnings.md#RECIPIENT_NOT_CONTRACT) (info), to catch a split address that was predicted but
   not created yet. (new)

Output: `Prepared<"createOvm">` (preview `{ factory: Address }`) calling `createObolValidatorManager(owner, principalRecipient,
rewardRecipient, thresholdGwei)`. The OVM address is not known before mining; read it with `ovmFromReceipt`.

To create a split on its own use [`splits.prepareCreateSplit`](https://github.com/ObolNetwork/obol-sdk/blob/080fa554c999b11c014f3f09be26274014ded0b9/spec/operations.md#splitspreparecreatesplit) (3.0.0-rc.12 removed the
alias `setup.prepareCreateSplit`).

<p class="sdk-muted">From <a href="https://github.com/ObolNetwork/obol-sdk/blob/080fa554c999b11c014f3f09be26274014ded0b9/spec/operations.md">spec/operations.md</a>.</p>

</details>

## Constants {#group-constants}

### setup.DEFAULT_PRINCIPAL_THRESHOLD {#DEFAULT_PRINCIPAL_THRESHOLD}

<div class="sdk-badges"><span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--pure" title="Exported from the namespace, not bound on the client">namespace only</span></div>

Default OVM principal threshold, 16 ETH in wei: a distribution of at least this much is
paid as principal while `amountOfPrincipalStake` lasts.

```ts sdk-signature
setup.DEFAULT_PRINCIPAL_THRESHOLD: bigint
```

**Example**

```ts
import { setup } from '@obolnetwork/obol-sdk';

console.log(setup.DEFAULT_PRINCIPAL_THRESHOLD); // 16 ETH in wei
```

<p class="sdk-see">See also: <a href="https://github.com/ObolNetwork/obol-sdk/blob/080fa554c999b11c014f3f09be26274014ded0b9/src/setup/ovm.ts#L36">source</a></p>
